regime_context: Detector shows a broad, non-one-narrative rotation with Base Metals & Copper leading narrowly over Oil & Gas Producers (margin 0.19), broad eligibility (9/16), and weak absorption (0.30); the only validated edge is absolute-trend gating for drawdown control, not return forecasting. Track record (n=95, hit rate 0.66 but direction accuracy only 0.35) says the directional calls have been poor, so leans are held to low conviction and framed as conditionals.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed leadership handoff from Base Metals to Oil & Gas Producers — observable condition: XEG.TO closes above XBM.TO on a 10-day rolling return basis AND Oil & Gas margin vs Base Metals exceeds 0.3 for two consecutive weeks. If that does not occur by mid-December, retire the watch.

theses.thesis: Highest score (1.74) and eligible with the trend gate passing. Breadth 0.556 is moderate, durability_bar 0.51 is mid-range and not yet strong. This is a focus-lean on prevailing leadership, not a return forecast; the gate only reduces drawdown risk.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Challenger at rank 2 (score 1.55) with the strongest breadth (0.643) and durable gap (durability_bar 0.64) among leaders. Narrow margin to leader (0.19) makes this a genuine rotational alternative; trend gate passing.
theses.dissent: Hurst 'mixed' with no persistent-trend tag means it could chop; challenger is not yet confirmed leader, and the detector's rotation-timing leg is display-only with no validated edge.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms XBM.TO by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Score is negative (-0.205) and crowding is flagged (crowding_z=1.22, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade, but combined with non-leadership this is a defensible avoid on risk-adjusted grounds.
theses.dissent: Hurst 'mixed' and high breadth (0.6) suggest underlying participation is broad; crowded flag alone has no basket-level forward edge and should not be read as a short

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the TSX benchmark by more than 3% before the check-by date
